== Notes ==
* This skill can fully refill its own adrenaline cost:
** at rank 6 or higher, with any effect that doubles adrenaline gain (i.e. [[Furious]] Sword Hilt or the skill [["For Great Justice!"]] in [[PvE]]);
** at rank 14 or higher, with any effect that grants at least one extra strike of adrenaline (e.g. [[Dark Fury]]);
** at rank 17 or higher, by its own effect alone.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] appears to feature a [[Dadao Sword]].
* [[Dragon]]s do not use Dragon Slash.
